item.title: Getting the OSWE Certification: 'Offensive Security Web Expert' (PEN-300) review
item.author: quactv
item.description: 10-06-2022 / 22 Year Old Finally, after almost a year since I earned the OSCP certification. Today, once again I was overjoyed to get an email from Offensive letting me know I had completed and earned the OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert) certification It feels wonderful after 3 months of hard study and more than 20 hours facing a grueling, difficult exam. I’m truly grateful to Offensive for the advanced knowledge the course brought me.
